column2: this lets you filter away functions that will

column1: not be recorded in the trace. It is similar to adding 'notrace' to those

set_ftrace_filter is set
column2: it removes all functions from the trace execpt for

column1: those listed in the set_ftrace_filter. set_ftrace_notrace will prevent those

set_ftrace_notrace and that function was the same

the set of functions to trace is:
set_ftrace_filter == empty then
all functions not in set_ftrace_notrace
